intent: Rebuild the Edu_core Parent PWA around a single principle: Zero-Clutter, High-Intent. The home screen is a chronological, event-driven feed where a UI component exists ONLY when a real data condition or deadline makes it relevant. A fee payment card appears days before a due date and disappears the moment the account is in good standing. A bus-tracking card exists only during commute windows. An absence alert exists only on the day the child was marked absent. Everything else stays out of the parent's way. The feed is sorted by time-of-day relevance and urgency, styled with the emotional design language (people, colors, chronology, motion), and backed by a server-side trigger engine that turns routine school data into active UI events. This prompt is written for an AI coding agent continuing the Edu_core implementation after the AMS UI/UX spec v1.2 (phases 1-9 landed on main; phases 10-11 of that plan are PAUSED and resume later exactly as written there).

meta.predecessor_spec: docs/uiux-spec.json (AMS/ClassHub/Student 360 spec, prompt_version 1.2). All shared components (AppModal, EmptyStateCTA, NextBestAction, Stepper, ConfirmDialog, Combobox, AddressAutofill, PersonalDemographicsPicker, ActivityFeed, NeedsAttentionCard, IdentityHeader) are either landed on main or will land with the paused Phase 10; import them, never fork them.
meta.paused_plan_status: AMS plan Phase 10 (form primitives + staff onboarding + address/demographics) and Phase 11 (acceptance AC13-AC20) are paused, not cancelled. Do not implement them here. Do not break their anchors.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS, dark: variants mandatory, existing semantic palette (primary #1e40af deep blue, secondary #059669 emerald, warning amber, danger rose, sidebar slate)
stack.pwa: Existing: frontend/public/manifest.json (standalone, theme #1e40af), frontend/public/sw.js privacy-hardened service worker. Extend, never weaken.
stack.realtime: Poll-driven via @tanstack/react-query (installed) with refetch intervals per card; no websocket dependency. BullMQ + ioredis + @schoolmitra/domain-events already installed for server-side event emission and scheduled jobs.
stack.payments: razorpay npm package already installed; paymentGatewayLogs table already models CREATED/ATTEMPTED/PAID/FAILED/REFUNDED; existing CheckoutButton.tsx in (parent)/portal is the payment entry point.
stack.i18n: next-intl already installed; every parent-facing string needs en and hi keys.
stack.deps_policy: No NEW npm dependencies. Everything this spec needs is already in package.json.

files_in_scope: frontend/src/app/(parent)/portal/** (DPDP portal: keep, deep-link from feed cards)
frontend/src/components/parent/* (new: FeedCard primitives, BusLiveCard, PaymentCard, etc.)
backend/src/lib/parentEventEngine/* (new: pure trigger functions + BullMQ jobs)
frontend/public/sw.js (extend cache rules only where marked)

current_state_audit: PARENT APP IS A STATIC MENU APP: (parent)/parent ships dashboard, attendance, bus, documents, fees, profile as separate routes behind static navigation. A parent must know where to look; the app never comes to them. Every transactional feature is always visible regardless of state (fee link is always in the nav even when nothing is due).

PWA SHELL ALREADY EXISTS: manifest.json declares standalone display, theme #1e40af, maskable icons. sw.js is privacy-hardened: it NEVER caches authenticated HTML navigations (network-only with /offline fallback), cache-first only for immutable /_next/static assets, and network-first-with-cache-fallback ONLY for /api/admit-cards/, /api/exams/datesheet, /api/report-cards/. Preserve every one of these rules verbatim.

PUSH INFRASTRUCTURE ALREADY EXISTS: userPushSubscriptions stores endpoint/p256dh/auth per user, pushNotificationLogs logs title/body/status, attendanceNotifications already routes attendance alerts to parentUserId over channel SMS/PUSH/EMAIL. The plumbing exists; what is missing is an event model that decides what to send, when, and with what priority.

FEES DATA MODEL IS ALREADY RICH: feeInvoices carries status (PENDING/PARTIAL/PAID/OVERDUE/WAIVED/CANCELLED), dueDate, netAmount, paidAmount, balanceAmount, lateFeeAmount, and reminderSentD7/D15/D30 flags. paymentGatewayLogs tracks Razorpay order lifecycle (CREATED, ATTEMPTED, PAID, FAILED, REFUNDED). feeInvoices has dueDate and status indexes. Everything needed to drive a conditional payment card already exists.

ATTENDANCE ALERTING PARTIALLY EXISTS: studentAttendance has status enum (PRESENT, ABSENT, LATE, HALF_DAY, LEAVE, HOLIDAY) and smsNotificationSent flags. There is no parent-facing in-app presentation of today's attendance beyond a route page.

TRANSPORT HAS GPS BUT NO ETA ENGINE: gpsPings stores vehicle lat/long/speed per ping; routeStops has gpsLatitude/gpsLongitude, stopOrder, and estimatedArrivalTime ('07:30'); studentBusPasses links student to route + stop with qrCodeData and isActive. There is no boarding/alighting event table yet (flag: do not invent one; bus tracking works from gpsPings + stopOrder proximity).

COMMUNICATION MODULE EXISTS: notices (audienceType PARENTS/CLASS/SECTION, isPinned, publishedAt, expiresAt, DOMPurify-sanitised content), events (eventType: HOLIDAY, EXAM, PTM, SPORTS, CULTURAL with startDate), parentTeacherMessages (moderated threads, isRead, DPDP audit trail). None of this reaches the parent home screen as a feed.

REPORT CARDS AND ADMIT CARDS ARE PARENT-ACCESSIBLE via (parent)/portal/report-cards and (parent)/portal/admit-cards with offline caching already in sw.js. examinations schema has markEntries and reportCards.
DPDP PORTAL EXISTS at (parent)/portal with consent and rights routes: parents manage consent and data rights there. The feed must deep-link into it, never duplicate it.

supporting_code_to_reuse.feed_primitives: From the AMS spec v1.2 design_feel layer: ActivityFeed (vertical timeline), NeedsAttentionCard (severity left-border + action), IdentityHeader (sticky entity header). Build FeedCard on these conventions: rounded-2xl card, avatar left, title, one-line human summary, relative timestamp, at most one primary action.
supporting_code_to_reuse.payment_flow: Reuse the existing CheckoutButton and razorpay server actions in (parent)/portal/actions.ts. Do not create a second payment path. The feed payment card calls the same action and shows the same receipt.
supporting_code_to_reuse.push_subscription: Reuse userPushSubscriptions and the existing subscription server logic; add only the tier/priority/dedupe policy layer defined in notification_matrix.
supporting_code_to_reuse.domain_events: Emit server events through @schoolmitra/domain-events and schedule derivation jobs with the existing BullMQ queues; do not introduce a new scheduler.
supporting_code_to_reuse.ordering: Reuse getCanonicalSortOrder (academicOrdering) for any class references; date-fns for relative timestamps (both already used in the codebase).

vectors.data: feeInvoices per student: status, dueDate, balanceAmount, lateFeeAmount, reminder flags
Razorpay order create + verify via existing actions
today's studentAttendance status, marked time, remarks
latest gpsPing for the bus on the student's active route, ordered stop list from routeStops
assignments and assignmentSubmissions for the student's class: due dates, submission status, grades
notices (audience PARENTS or student's class/section), events (PTM within 7 days), parentTeacherMessages unread

gaps_and_decisions: No boarding scan table exists. Bus tracking uses gpsPings + routeStops only: compute the bus's nearest passed stop (haversine on latest ping vs stop coordinates) and derive 'N stops away' from stopOrder distance to the student's stop. Do not create a boarding event table in this track.
No per-student push preference table exists. Add parentNotificationPreferences (parentUserId, tier opt-outs, quietHoursOverride) as a minimal new table; default quiet hours 21:30-07:00 local.

analytics_layer.philosophy: Explainable rule-based signals computed server-side, never client-side, never third-party, never a black box. Every number a parent sees must be traceable to a simple rule the school can defend. No ML dependencies; threshold logic lives in pure functions with unit tests.

descriptive_analytics.compute: present+late days / total school days, last 30 days, from studentAttendance
descriptive_analytics.display: sparkline via recharts inside the child's profile header and attendance card
receipt list with status chips; no chart needed

descriptive_analytics.compute: last 2 published report card averages per subject
descriptive_analytics.display: delta arrows on report card card and portal

predictive_analytics.rule: absent/leave on 3+ of the last 10 school days OR rolling 30-day attendance below 85%
predictive_analytics.output: amber InsightCard 'Attendance is slipping' with trend sparkline and a 'Talk to class teacher' action (opens existing parentTeacherMessages thread)

predictive_analytics.rule: latest published report card average dropped more than 10 points vs the previous one
predictive_analytics.output: amber InsightCard 'Maths dropped from 78 to 64' naming the subject, with the report card deep link

predictive_analytics.rule: invoice OVERDUE, OR two or more reminderSent flags set on the current invoice
predictive_analytics.output: calm payment card escalation (see emotional_ux): neutral copy first, overdue states add late-fee facts, never shame language

predictive_analytics.rule: 2+ assignmentSubmissions missing past due date in the last 14 days
predictive_analytics.output: amber InsightCard listing the assignments, action opens documents/homework list

trigger_engine.service: backend/src/lib/parentEventEngine/: pure function deriveParentFeed(studentId, now, dataSnapshot) -> FeedCard[] plus BullMQ jobs to persist derived card states in parentFeedCards (studentId, cardType, tier, payload jsonb, activatedAt, expiresAt, dismissedAt).
trigger_engine.promotion_rule: A data point becomes an ACTIVE UI EVENT only when: (a) a deadline is inside its window, (b) a state transition just happened, or (c) an analytics rule fired. Everything else stays queryable behind the child's profile, invisible on the feed.
trigger_engine.card_ttl: Every card has expiresAt: bus cards at commute window end, attendance cards at 20:00 same day, fee cards at payment confirmation (+2h so the success state can render), notice cards at 72h or expiresAt, insight cards at 7 days unless the rule still fires.

analytics_layer.privacy: Signals are computed per student inside schoolId scope. Nothing is persisted that is not already lawfully held; parentNotificationPreferences is the only new personal data. DPDP consent flows in (parent)/portal are untouched; InsightCards respect the same consent posture (aggregate status, no raw data export).

event_driven_ui.home_contract: The dashboard route becomes a single feed: server component derives card states, client FeedCard components render them with react-query polling per card tier (Tier 1: 60s, Tier 2: 10min, Tier 3: on-demand after action). Zero cards is a VALID state: it renders a calm Today strip and the child's identity header only, never placeholder clutter.

card_catalog.hide_when: all invoices PAID/WAIVED (render PaymentSuccessCard for 2h after a payment, then nothing)
card_catalog.content: student name + invoice term + balanceAmount + due countdown chip ('Due in 3 days' amber / 'Overdue - late fee added' rose); primary action 'Pay Now' opens Razorpay flow from the existing CheckoutButton action; secondary 'View breakdown' opens the fees page
card_catalog.micro_progress: after payment: 'Processing' (ATTEMPTED) -> 'Paid' (PAID from paymentGatewayLogs) with sonner toast and receipt deep link

card_catalog.render_when: today's studentAttendance status in (ABSENT, LATE, HALF_DAY, LEAVE)
card_catalog.hide_when: status PRESENT or HOLIDAY or no record yet after the school's attendance cutoff (default 10:00 local; PRESENT renders only as a quiet line inside the Today strip, never a card)
card_catalog.content: rose/amber left border, avatar, 'Aarav was marked Absent today at 09:12', teacher remarks if present, secondary action 'Message class teacher'

card_catalog.render_when: student has active studentBusPass AND now is inside a commute window (school-configured, defaults 06:30-08:30 and 14:00-17:30 local, weekdays)
card_catalog.hide_when: outside windows, weekends, holidays, or no active pass
card_catalog.content: leaflet mini-map (one vehicle marker + student stop marker), 'Bus is 2 stops away' from haversine + stopOrder, ETA from gpsPings speed history, auto-collapse to a chip with live dot when scrolled past
card_catalog.micro_progress: stops-away countdown updates at the Tier 1 poll interval; 'Arrived at stop' -> 'Departed' transitions

card_catalog.render_when: assignment due within 48h with no submission OR submission graded in last 24h
card_catalog.hide_when: no pending-near-due or recently graded homework
card_catalog.content: 'Maths worksheet due tomorrow' with subject icon; graded variant shows grade chip and one-line teacher feedback if present

card_catalog.render_when: reportCard published and not yet opened by this parent (track first-viewed timestamp in payload)
card_catalog.content: emerald gradient celebration: 'Term 1 report card is ready', average + delta arrows per marks_trend, primary 'Open report card' deep-links to (parent)/portal/report-cards (offline-capable per sw.js)

card_catalog.render_when: events row with eventType PTM and startDate within 7 days
card_catalog.content: date/time block, venue, 'Add reminder' secondary action; joins school calendar from events table

card_catalog.render_when: notices with isPinned or publishedAt within 72h targeting PARENTS or the student's class/section
card_catalog.content: title + 2-line DOMPurify preview, pinned badge, deep link to notice detail

card_catalog.render_when: pending DPDP consent or rights request
card_catalog.content: amber card, primary action deep-links into (parent)/portal/consent (never re-implements consent UI)
NeedsAttentionCard variant: severity border, one-line finding with the actual numbers, one primary action

card_catalog.render_when: unread parentTeacherMessages count > 0 in last 7 days
card_catalog.content: teacher avatar + name + last message preview, primary opens the thread

time_of_day_choreography.morning_0630_0930: BusLiveCard pinned top; AttendanceCard appears the moment attendance is marked.
time_of_day_choreography.midday_0930_1400: Notices, PTM, Consent cards; HomeworkCard for today's due items.
time_of_day_choreography.evening_1700_2130: HomeworkCard (due tomorrow), PaymentCard (if active), ReportCardCard; this is the highest-engagement window.
time_of_day_choreography.night_2130_0630: Feed frozen with staleness note if data is old; no push (quiet hours).

notification_matrix.style_reference: Quick-commerce micro-progress (Swiggy/Zepto/Instamart): every tracked entity has a visible lifecycle, progress updates are short and factual, and tracking lives where the user already is.

events: fee OVERDUE with late fee accruing
bus within 2 stops of student's stop (only inside commute window)
tiers.limits: max 3 T1 pushes per parent per day; dedupe by (studentId, eventKind, calendarDay); quiet hours 21:30-07:00 local queue the push for 07:00 but render the feed card immediately

channels: feed card only; no push except report card ready which gets one push
tiers.limits: no push sounds; batched digest never (feed is the digest)

channels: sonner toast in-app + quiet feed line

micro_progress_catalog.states: Scheduled -> En route -> N stops away -> Arrived at stop -> Departed -> Completed
Initiating -> Processing (Razorpay ATTEMPTED) -> Paid (PAID) -> Receipt ready
Exams done -> Being graded (all examSchedules past, marks not yet published) -> Published -> Opened

tone_laws: Celebration is earned and brief: ReportCardCard gets the only gradient in the app; keep it under 8s of visual festivity (shimmer + emerald), then it becomes a normal card.
Alerts are calm and specific: 'Aarav was marked Absent today at 09:12' beats 'Attendance alert!'. Rose border only for same-day facts; amber for forward-looking risk.
Money is never shameful: PaymentCard copy is neutral and factual ('Term 2 fee of Rs 12,500 is due in 3 days'), overdue adds only the late-fee fact. Never 'defaulter' in parent-facing copy.
Chronology grounds trust: every card shows relative time ('2h ago', 'Due tomorrow'); the Today strip always shows the date and weekday first.
People over data: child's avatar + first name everywhere (AMS law L12 applies); teacher messages show teacher avatars.
emotional_ux.language: next-intl keys for every string: en + hi. Card titles use sentence case, verbs first where an action exists ('Pay Term 2 fee', 'Open report card').

surfaces.file: frontend/src/app/(parent)/parent/dashboard/page.tsx (rewritten as feed home, route stays for installed PWAs)
changes: Today strip: date, weekday, quiet summary line ('All good today' or '2 things need you').
Child IdentityHeader: avatar, name, class-section, attendance sparkline chip, sticky on scroll.
Feed of FeedCards ordered by tier then recency, per time_of_day_choreography; empty feed is a valid, calm state.

Bottom navigation shrinks to: Home (feed), Child (profile/records), Messages, More. Transactional links (fees, bus, documents) move OUT of permanent nav into feed cards and the Child/More pages; nav never grows past 4 items.
PaymentCard on the feed is the only proactive fee surface; the fees page becomes history: past invoices, receipts, breakdowns, downloaded receipts via existing receiptS3Key flow.
Razorpay lifecycle micro-progress from paymentGatewayLogs; idempotency via existing idempotencyKey.
Post-payment NextBestAction: 'Download receipt' primary, 'Back to today' secondary.
Leaflet mini-map inside the feed card; full map on expanding to the bus page.
ETA engine: nearest-stop via haversine on the latest gpsPing against routeStops coordinates, stops-away = stopOrder delta, ETA from ping speed; render 'N stops away' with a live dot.
No boarding events, no driver chat, no geofence alerts beyond the T1 'within 2 stops' push.
HomeworkCard + ReportCardCard per the card catalog; report card deep link to the portal route that sw.js already caches offline.
Marks trend deltas on the report card screen via marks_trend.
Moderated parentTeacherMessages threads with read receipts (existing isRead/readAt), avatar-first rendering.
Notice detail page keeps DOMPurify sanitisation and attachment download via S3 presigned URL.
Child profile page absorbs the old attendance/bus/documents/fees pages as sections (progressive disclosure, collapsible groups, max 7 visible rows per group).

acceptance_criteria: AC-P1: ZERO-CLUTTER RULE VERIFIED: with all invoices paid, no bus pass, attendance PRESENT, and no notices, the home feed renders only the Today strip and child header. Grep the feed page: no card renders unconditionally.
AC-P2: PaymentCard renders for a PENDING invoice inside 7 days of dueDate, for PARTIAL, and for OVERDUE; it does not render for PAID/WAIVED/CANCELLED.
AC-P3: BusLiveCard renders only within the configured commute window on a school day with an active studentBusPass; outside the window the bus page shows the schedule, never a live map.
AC-P4: T1 pushes respect the 3/day cap, dedupe key, and 21:30-07:00 quiet hours; unit tests cover the limiter.
AC-P5: deriveParentFeed is a pure function with unit tests covering every card type's render/hide conditions and TTLs.
AC-P6: All strings resolve through next-intl in en and hi; switching language flips every card including micro-progress.
AC-P7: sw.js privacy rules unchanged byte-for-byte except any explicitly commented additions; authenticated HTML is never cached.
AC-P8: Report card and admit card deep links work offline after first view (existing sw cache rules).
AC-P9: Analytics signals are pure functions with unit tests: attendance_risk, performance_dip, fee_stress, homework_neglect.
AC-P10: Dark mode complete on every card; every color used comes from the existing semantic palette; the ReportCardCard gradient is the only gradient.
AC-P11: No new npm dependencies; pnpm-lock.yaml unchanged.
AC-P12: All click budgets in this spec verified manually and listed in the PR description.
constraints: Do not alter tenant isolation, RBAC checks, DPDP consent flows, or the fees/exam lock logic.
Do not implement AMS plan phases 10-11 (paused); import shared components that exist on main, and leave clean seams (imports, props) where the paused phases will land theirs.
Reuse the razorpay actions in (parent)/portal; one payment path only.
No third-party analytics SDK, no ML library, no geofencing service, no new realtime transport.
Never persist derived feed cards beyond their TTL; the feed is derived state, not a second source of truth.
Parent-facing copy never uses the words defaulter, risk score, or churn; insights state facts.
implementation_order: Phase P1: parentEventEngine pure functions + deriveParentFeed + parentFeedCards persistence + full unit tests (no UI).
Phase P2: analytics signals (parentSignals.ts) + nightly BullMQ jobs + tests.
Phase P3: FeedCard primitive set + surface_p0 home feed + Today strip + IdentityHeader + choreography.
Phase P4: PaymentCard + payment micro-progress + fees history page.
Phase P5: BusLiveCard + ETA engine + leaflet integration.
Phase P6: remaining cards (attendance, homework, report card, PTM, notice, consent, insight, message) + portal deep links.
Phase P7: notification matrix: tier router, limiter, quiet hours, web push wiring over userPushSubscriptions.
Phase P8: emotional UX + bilingual pass + dark mode sweep + manifest.json parent shortcuts (Pay Fees, Bus Live) + AC-P1..P12 acceptance audit.
definition_of_done: The parent app has no idle state and no clutter: the home feed contains exactly what today's data says matters, every card can explain when asked why it exists, money and alerts speak calmly, the bus and the report card and the payment all track like an order being fulfilled, and a parent with nothing pending sees a serene screen that says the school has everything under control. AMS phases 10-11 remain cleanly paused and resumable.

usage: Save as docs/parent-pwa-spec.json alongside docs/uiux-spec.json and reference it from AGENTS.md as the active track.
One phase per agent task, in order; each phase is a standalone task boundary with tests and commits, same convention as the AMS plan.
Before editing any file in files_in_scope, read it fully; the audit reflects commit 669047d and main has since received AMS phases 1-9, so re-verify anchors first.

If a shared component from the AMS spec is missing because Phase 10 is paused, build the minimal local fallback behind the same import path contract and leave a TODO referencing the paused phase; never block on it.
Security constraints (RBAC, tenant isolation, DPDP, PII encryption, sw.js privacy rules) always win over any spec conflict; log the conflict in task notes.
